poc_summary: Hosted API pilot highlights: 1) Stability good, no timeouts. 2) Observed average latency (generation only) p50=110ms for short prompts, p95=430ms for long-context summarizations. 3) Token mix skewed: 62% short interactions (~40-120 prompt tokens), 38% longer summarization/search re-ranks (~500-1,200 prompt tokens). 4) Average prompt_tokens=400, completion_tokens=120, avg_total_tokens=520. 5) Prefix caching test: ~18% cost reduction on repeated Qs. 6) Need Dedicated to meet projected growth (10-20x) and VPC isolation.
traffic_forecast_qps: Current observed peak QPS (trial): 4-6. Growth plan: 10x in 6 months -> baseline forecast for Dedicated: steady-state 40 QPS, seasonal peaks (end-of-month reports) up to 120 QPS.
concurrency_target: Target concurrency for Dedicated capacity planning: 16-24 concurrent requests (based on 50ms token generation paths + average token counts); target p50 latency goal: <200ms for short replies.
token_mix_summary: Projected token mix by workload: 60% short chat (prompt 40-150 tokens, completion 20-60), 30% semantic-search/embeddings (short prompts, embedding size 1536, batched), 10% long summarization/rerank (prompt 400-1200, completion 100-400). Avg tokens/request ~520 currently; expect avg to drift to ~380 with prompt engineering and caching.
pricing_sensitivity: High - finance requires three pricing scenarios: (1) Hosted-tier uplift for committed volume, (2) Dedicated small pool (2-4 GPUs) with autoscale burst, (3) Dedicated enterprise with reserved monthly commit. Break-even target: < $0.008 per effective request (post-Optimize recommendations).
